title: Sustainable asthma inhalers: who is offered the option to change, who declines and who successfully switches?
content: The healthcare community recognises the need for lower emission inhaler options; however, in the UK, most inhalers prescribed are pressurised metered dose inhalers (pMDIs) despite dry powder inhalers (DPIs) having a markedly lower carbon footprint as they do not contain propellants. For this reason, UK clinicians have been encouraged to offer switches from pMDIs to DPIs where feasible. Using data from the Asthma+Lung UK's 'Life with a Lung Condition' 2023 online survey, demographic, economic and clinical factors were analysed to determine who had and had not been offered a switch; whose switch had been successful and why some respondents chose not to switch. 9960 people with asthma responded (77.9% female; age 59.9±13.0) and 7059 (87.7%) were pMDI users. The 3753 (53.2%) who were offered a pMDI to DPI switch had a greater awareness of lower-emission inhaler options (72% vs 53.2%*), uncontrolled asthma (61% vs 54.1%*), and had required unscheduled healthcare (27.4% vs 21.2%*) or >2 courses oral corticosteroids (27.6% vs 21.6%*) in the last year (all *p<0.001). 432 (11.5%) opted not to change inhaler when offered. 3321 (88.5%) accepted the switch and it was successful in 2126 (64%). In a large UK survey of people with asthma, over half of those on pMDIs had been offered a switch. It was successful in most who attempted it but unsuccessful switches were associated with subjective and objective markers of poor disease control. Some patients decline the switch because they like their pMDI, but some have ongoing concerns about the efficacy and safety of a DPI and is most feasible when integrated into routine reviews for patients with stable disease, alongside ongoing efforts to optimise asthma outcomes.

title: Patient perspective on lymphoedema after breast cancer: evidence for 3D micro-massage compression.
content: Approximately 55 900 women are diagnosed with breast cancer in the UK each year, and around one in five develop lymphoedema following treatment. Breast, trunk and arm lymphoedema arise from disruption to shared lymphatic drainage pathways during axillary surgery and radiotherapy, yet the condition remains under-recognised and under-referred in many post-treatment care pathways and women can struggle to find appropriate bras to support their care needs. This article explores why and where lymphoedema develops after breast cancer treatment, presents the patient experience of living with breast and trunk lymphoedema, and evaluates the clinical evidence for 3D micro-massage compression technology - specifically the Solidea® Silver Wave Skin Bra - as an adjunct to standard lymphoedema management. This article combines a narrative review of current evidence on breast and trunk lymphoedema with first-person patient testimony and findings from a pilot audit of 21 women with breast and/or trunk lymphoedema following breast cancer treatment. Audit outcome measures included the clinician-completed Breast Symptom Assessment Score, the wearer-completed Self-Report Symptom Rating Scale, structured wearer feedback and qualitative telephone follow up at approximately 26 days and 11 weeks. Women sometimes report a delay between symptom onset and receiving support, alongside difficulty sourcing an appropriate, comfortable bra; these issues are compounded further for those wearing a breast prosthesis. In the pilot audit, mean Breast Symptom Assessment Score reduced by 60% (from 5.8 to 2.3) over approximately 26 days, with moderate-to-severe swelling falling from 70% to 15%, breast hardness from 90% to 65%, and night-time discomfort from 85% to 45%. All 20 completing participants showed improvement, with 100% rating comfort as excellent or good; the lowest-rated domain in self-reported symptoms scales was degree of support, particularly among women with cup sizes above D. Breast and trunk lymphoedema is common, chronic and profoundly life-limiting, with psychological and social impact that compounds the burden of breast cancer treatment. Proactive risk information, early referral and holistic support are essential. 3D micro-massage compression may support self-management alongside complete decongestive therapy, but clinicians should consider patient suitability and the current evidence gaps in larger-breasted women and other garment formats.

title: Citing barefoot Beed woman’s ‘struggle’, Bombay High Court gives mother children’s custody
content:
5 min readNew DelhiUpdated: Sep 7, 2026 03:30 PM IST

To afford her daughter’s education, 47-year-old Ramabai Ranvir ran three kilometres to win a Rs 3,000 cash prize in Maharashtra’s Beed district. Citing her extraordinary sacrifice while hearing a family matter, the Bombay High Court underlined the heavy burdens mothers often carry to secure their children’s future — and granted a woman custody of her two minor children.
Justice Rajesh S Patil said the incident was a “reminder” that a mother’s struggle to raise and educate her children is not always reflected merely in “figures” placed before the court. Behind those figures often lies a continuing “endeavour” to balance limited means against the ever-growing necessities of food, shelter, education and a dignified existence, he added.
“The court cannot remain ignorant of the realities of life which confront a woman who, while striving to secure the future of her children, is simultaneously required to attend to the necessities of her own day-to-day existence,” the September 3 order observed.
Noting that the husband himself, on a stamp paper, had admitted that he has an extramarital affair, the court held that in such circumstances, it could not be said that the children would be in a healthy environment in the father’s custody.
The high court was hearing a revision plea filed by the mother challenging a sessions court’s order that had granted interim custody of the two minor children to their father till the final disposal of the proceedings, while giving her only visitation rights.
Domestic violence complaint
The wife had filed a domestic violence complaint and an interim application seeking custody of her two children. The application was allowed after the judicial magistrate interviewed both children. Aggrieved, the husband challenged the order before the sessions court, which held that the allegation about the husband’s extramarital affair would not affect the interim application for custody of the minor children.
Justice Rajesh S Patil said the incident in Beed is a ‘reminder’ that a mother’s struggle to raise and educate her children is not always reflected merely in figures placed before the court.
The wife then filed this petition before the high court seeking interim custody of her daughter and son, claiming that she has recently joined the service of a company and earns a salary of Rs 13,000 per month.
Story continues below this ad
‘Children can live with grandparents’
The wife, through advocate Avesh Ghadge, claimed that her parents and her two married brothers live together, and both brothers have taken up the responsibility of her welfare, as well as that of her two children, both emotionally and financially.
She further claimed that her brothers’ children were around the same age as her own children and they would be able to enjoy each other’s company while living together with their maternal grandparents and uncles.
The woman alleged that both children were studying in a CBSE school. However, after the couple started living separately, the husband, whom she accused of often being drunk and also of having an extramarital affair, removed them from the school and admitted them to a state board school.
The husband, through his advocate Vijay V Patil, denied the allegations of an extramarital affair and that he was often inebriated. He submitted that both children were happily staying with him and their grandparents, who were taking care of them with love and affection. It was also argued that their present school was only around 100 to 150 metres from his residence.
Story continues below this ad
The man also claimed that his wife did not have an income source to meet the educational and other expenses of the children.
Children tutored, in-laws helpless: HC
The court found that the wife was not seeking custody as a means of obtaining financial support or any monetary advantage from her husband, as she had not claimed maintenance or alimony for herself. It noted that the daughter, being 12 years old and approaching puberty, would require more company of her mother, while the six-year-old son would also require his mother’s company.
After interacting with both children, the court found that they appeared to have been “tutored” by the husband. It also noted that the woman’s brothers had agreed and orally undertaken to take care of her and her children.
“They (wife and her brothers) do not require any kind of alimony or maintenance from respondent number 1 (husband) for their sister or towards her children,” the court noted.
Story continues below this ad
The court also interacted with the man’s parents and found them to be helpless. “As far as a healthy environment for the upbringing of the children is concerned, it is respondent number 1 (husband) who has, on a stamp paper, admitted that he has an extra-marital affair,” it added.
After considering the case, the court held that for the better future of the children and taking into account a better environment for them, the mother should get their custody.
The court directed the husband to hand over both children to the mother on September 9, and allowed the man to meet the children every Sunday till the final disposal of their case.

title: Reportan la excarcelación de dos presos políticos recluidos en Yare II
content:
El Comité por la Libertad de los Presos Políticos (Clippve) informó la noche del martes la liberación de Renny Regino González y Nudre Javier Chourio, presos políticos que estaban recluidos en Yare II.
La organización compartió una fotografía en la que aparecen González y Chourio junto a Manuel Bohórquez, quien fue procesado por la misma causa y ya había sido excarcelado bajo régimen de presentación.

Se esperan más excarcelaciones

title: Life-extending breast cancer drug made available on the NHS after U-turn
content:
Life-extending breast cancer drug made available on the NHS after U-turn
The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (Nice) announced that it has reversed an initial decision to reject the drug for widespread use for the NHS in England
- Bookmark
- CommentsGo to comments
Breast cancer patients have said they are "thrilled" after the health spending watchdog approved a life-extending drug for NHS use.
However, campaigners said that some patients living with incurable breast cancer that has spread to other parts of the body have "died waiting" for Enhertu.
The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (Nice) announced it has reversed an earlier decision rejecting the treatment for widespread NHS use in England.
In 2024, it previously stated that the treatment was "not cost effective".
It has now confirmed the drug will be provided "from today" for roughly 1,000 women with HER2-low advanced breast cancer, after a "commercial solution has now been agreed".
The therapy has been available to patients in Scotland for more than two years.
It is the first licensed targeted treatment for patients with HER2-low breast cancer that cannot be removed surgically or that has spread to other parts of the body, also known as metastatic breast cancer.
Clinical trials have found that women with breast cancer who took the drug survived for around two years, compared with 17.5 months for those who had chemotherapy.
Paula Van Santen, who was diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer in July 2022, said that the announcement has given her a “new sense of hope”.
Mother-of-three Ms Van Santen, 51, from Banbury, said: “Today is a day I never thought I’d see.
“After years of waiting and hoping, there aren’t enough words to express how thrilled I am to see Enhertu finally approved for use on the NHS.
“Having access to this life-extending treatment brings a new sense of hope.
“It gives me the chance of seeing my daughter graduate from university, become a grandparent for the first time and simply be a mum to my children for longer as they continue to grow.
“These are life’s simple privileges that many of us take for granted, but which mean everything to me and thousands of others living with incurable metastatic breast cancer. That’s the difference a decision like this can make.”
Patient Kathryn Hulland, 48, said the decision would give her more time with her nine-year-old daughter Grace.
Ms Hulland, from Devon, was diagnosed with metastatic breast cancer in 2022.
She said: “I may still be here to support my nine-year-old daughter into high school.
“When I was first diagnosed, I was told I’d be lucky to see 12 months.
“Three years later I know how important every extra month is. It’s another chance at more time with my daughter, another chance to make memories together, another month to be her mum and see her grow.
“And that’s the hope this life-extending treatment now brings, it means everything.”
Charity Breast Cancer Now hailed the announcement as “momentous”.
Claire Rowney, chief executive, said: “After more than two years of relentless campaigning, Enhertu has been recommended by Nice for use on the NHS in England for people with HER2-low metastatic breast cancer.
“This is a momentous day for thousands of people who will now have access to a drug that will give them the opportunity to gain precious extra time with loved ones. More ordinary days that become extraordinary because they were there.
“This milestone victory belongs to every person who refused to accept that access to a life-extending treatment was out of reach. For people in England, the wait for Enhertu is finally over. We must now also see Wales and Northern Ireland make Enhertu available for use on the NHS for those who need more time to live.”
She added: “Since 2024 when it was first rejected for use, thousands of people have missed out on access to Enhertu and tragically many have died. We remember with deep gratitude the women who stood alongside us and fought for this very moment.”
Nice said that a commercial solution has now been agreed for Enhertu, also know as trastuzumab deruxtecan made by Daiichi Sankyo and Astra Zeneca, following changes made to its methods as part of the UK/US Pharmaceutical Pricing Agreement.
Helen Knight, director of medicines evaluation at Nice, said: “I’m pleased that a commercial solution, alongside recent changes to Nice’s cost-effectiveness thresholds and the use of new methods for assessing quality-of-life, has meant this treatment can now be provided on the NHS.
“However, we know this decision comes too late for many families, and our thoughts are with them today. Our role is important in ensuring NHS spending on new medicines reflects the benefits they deliver while protecting valuable health resources for other essential patient services.”
Dr Anne Rigg, consultant medical oncologist and NHS England’s national specialty adviser for chemotherapy, said: “This is hugely positive news for women with secondary breast cancer who will now be offered this life-extending treatment on the NHS, giving them the opportunity for more time with their loved ones.”
Tom Keith-Roach, UK country president for AstraZeneca, said: “Today’s announcement marks a vital milestone for women in England living with HER2 low metastatic breast cancer. It brings access into line with Scotland and 26 other European countries, offering renewed hope to more than 1,000 women living with this particularly aggressive form of the disease.”

title: O país que reacendeu a luz
content:
Escrevo-vos esta semana da Cidade do Cabo, onde estou a trabalho há mais de duas semanas, e começo por uma banalidade que aqui não é banal nenhuma. São dez da noite e a luz está acesa. Escrevo isto sem ironia, porque há três anos esta frase seria, neste país, uma declaração de sorte.
Em 2023, a África do Sul teve cortes programados de eletricidade em 332 dos 365 dias do ano. Não é gralha. Trezentos e trinta e dois. Chamavam-lhe load shedding, um eufemismo administrativo para dizer que se apagava o país por turnos, bairro a bairro, para a rede não colapsar de vez. Hospitais operavam a gerador. Restaurantes fechavam a meio do serviço. Uma produtora de vinho de Stellenbosch, a uma hora de onde escrevo, contava o gerador entre os seus ativos mais valiosos. Em fevereiro de 2023, o presidente Ramaphosa declarou estado de calamidade nacional e classificou a crise elétrica como ameaça existencial à economia e ao tecido social do país.
O último corte programado aconteceu a 16 de maio de 2025. Quando lerem estas linhas, a África do Sul terá completado perto de quinhentos dias consecutivos sem um único apagão. A disponibilidade das centrais subiu de 54,6% para 65,2%. As avarias não programadas caíram de 32,3% para 22,9%. Pouparam-se cerca de 27 mil milhões de rands em gasóleo de emergência em três anos, qualquer coisa como 1,3 mil milhões de euros queimados em geradores que deixaram de ser precisos. E a S&P subiu a notação financeira da Eskom, a elétrica estatal, pela primeira vez em uma década.
A pergunta que me trouxe a este texto é simples. Como é que um país que a Europa gosta de tratar com condescendência consegue, em três anos, o que continentes inteiros discutem há vinte?
A resposta é decepcionante, e é por isso que é boa. Não houve revolução tecnológica nenhuma. Houve manutenção.
Houve, em primeiro lugar, a coisa mais aborrecida do mundo, parar as centrais a horas para as arranjar, em vez de as empurrar até à avaria. Houve, depois, uma decisão pragmática sobre o nuclear, a extensão por vinte anos da vida dos dois reatores de Koeberg, aqui perto, que produzem energia barata e constante e que uma leitura mais militante teria mandado encerrar. E houve, sobretudo, uma terceira decisão, a mais difícil de todas, e que merece ser contada com cuidado porque é o coração deste artigo. A África do Sul adiou deliberadamente a sua transição energética.
Convém perceber porquê, e a história tem nome próprio, chama-se Komati.
A central de Komati funcionava desde 1961 e foi escolhida, em 2022, para ser a joia da coroa da transição justa sul-africana, o caso exemplar que o mundo inteiro visitaria. Encerraram-na e prometeram convertê-la num polo de renováveis, com apoio internacional e financiamento do Banco Mundial. Passaram-se quatro anos. A central está fechada, a conversão arrastou-se, a comunidade à volta empobreceu e antigos trabalhadores continuam sem emprego. O projeto que ia ser a referência global tornou-se o aviso global.
A frase que o presidente executivo da Eskom, Dan Marokane, usou para explicar a mudança de rumo devia ser pregada à porta de todos os ministérios europeus da energia. Estamos todos de acordo, disse ele, em que não devemos repetir Komati. E a partir daí a empresa fez o contrário do planeado, manteve em funcionamento dezassete unidades a carvão em cinco centrais que estavam marcadas para fechar, autorizadas agora a operar até 2030, e empurrou o encerramento de outras para algures entre 2035 e 2040.
E aqui entra uma peça que vejo daqui, literalmente. Quem sai da Cidade do Cabo para norte cruza-se com fileiras de turbinas eólicas a girar num vento que nesta ponta de África não dá tréguas. As províncias do Cabo são as mais ventosas do país, e a África do Sul tem já 34 parques eólicos em funcionamento, cerca de 3400 megawatts, quase todos de produtores privados. Ora, aqui está o pormenor que confirma tudo o que venho dizendo. Em 2022, no pior da crise, não se ligou à rede um único megawatt novo de eólica. Não por falta de vento, nem de investidores, nem de parques prontos. Faltava a rede. As linhas de transporte nas províncias do Cabo estavam saturadas e não tinham por onde escoar a energia. O vento estava lá, os moinhos estavam lá, faltava o cabo. A Eskom estima em cerca de 210 mil milhões de rands, uns 10 mil milhões de euros, o investimento em linhas de transporte de que precisa para ligar as renováveis já aprovadas. E foi só depois de estabilizar a base, com o carvão a funcionar e o nuclear prolongado, que começou a desbloquear ligações e a aprovar, para 2029, o maior parque eólico privado da história do país, 720 megawatts no Karoo. O vento é o futuro deste país. Mas não se pendura o futuro numa rede que não aguenta o presente.
Não estou a defender o carvão, e quero ser claro nisto porque é matéria onde a má-fé se instala depressa. O que aqui se decidiu não foi que o carvão é bom, foi que a ordem dos fatores altera profundamente o produto. Primeiro garante-se que há luz e que há rede. Depois faz-se a transição, ao ritmo a que a substituição estiver efetivamente construída, e não ao ritmo a que a conferência internacional aplaude. A África do Sul tentou a sequência inversa uma vez, em Komati, e pagou-a com uma comunidade inteira.
Agora olhem para a Europa, e digam-me qual das duas sequências reconhecem.
A Alemanha desligou os seus últimos reatores nucleares em abril de 2023, em plena crise energética, e passou a importar eletricidade, incluindo a nuclear francesa que tinha decidido não produzir. Um continente que encerrou capacidade instalada em nome de metas e depois descobriu que precisava de comprar a quem não fechou nada. Que hoje paga a eletricidade industrial duas a três vezes mais cara do que os Estados Unidos e a China, como já aqui escrevi, e que vê a sua indústria mudar de morada por causa disso. A Europa não fez o percurso de Komati numa central, fez o percurso de Komati num continente, e continua a chamar-lhe liderança climática.
E há um remate que fecha o círculo com uma coisa que escrevi há umas semanas. Com a rede estabilizada e, pela primeira vez em muitos anos, com capacidade excedentária, a Eskom anda agora a fazer uma coisa impensável em 2023, a namorar centros de dados. A Amazon, a Microsoft, a Google, a Equinix e a Teraco olham para a África do Sul como destino para a infraestrutura que vai treinar a inteligência artificial. É exatamente a mesma corrida que descrevi a propósito do Paraguai e de Itaipu. Muda a geografia, não muda o critério. Quem tem energia fiável e barata recebe o futuro. Quem tem discurso recebe visitas de estudo.
Falta a parte que qualquer texto honesto tem de incluir, e é o preço desta recuperação, que existe e não é pequeno.
Quem a paga é o consumidor sul-africano. As tarifas subiram 8,76% em abril, sobem 9,01% para os clientes municipais desde julho, e já está aprovada nova subida de 8,83% para o exercício seguinte, o que dá mais de 18% acumulados em dois anos. Há economistas locais a dizer, com razão, que esta trajetória é insustentável, que corrói o rendimento das famílias e encarece os custos da indústria. A frota a carvão é velha e cada adiamento torna o encerramento seguinte mais difícil de executar. E há quem chame a isto, sem contemplações, uma transição avariada, um país fechado no carvão. São críticas sérias e não as escondo, até porque confirmam a regra de que não existem almoços grátis, existem almoços com fatura diferida.
Mas reparem no que continua a ser verdade depois de descontado tudo isso. Este país pagou caro para voltar a ter luz. A Europa está a pagar caro para ter cada vez menos. A diferença entre as duas faturas não está no valor, está no que se comprou com ela.
Termino com a impressão pessoal, que é a razão de vos escrever daqui. Cheguei a este país a 4 de setembro preparado para o apagão, com a lanterna do telemóvel carregada e a expectativa de quem leu as notícias de 2023. Em mais de duas semanas, não foi precisa uma única vez. E enquanto trabalho, à noite, com a luz acesa e sem sobressalto, dou por mim a pensar numa ironia que me parece o resumo da década. Um país que muita gente na Europa não hesitaria em classificar como emergente, com todos os problemas que tem, e são muitos e graves, conseguiu resolver a pergunta mais elementar que um Estado deve responder aos seus cidadãos, se haverá luz amanhã. E fê-lo porque teve a humildade de admitir que se tinha enganado na ordem das coisas, e a coragem de voltar atrás.
É uma humildade que, olhando para o outro lado do mundo, faria muita falta a continentes bastante mais orgulhosos.

title: Asian Games open with more athletes than Summer Olympics and some unfamiliar sports
content:
The opening ceremony of the Asian Games on Saturday marked the official start of the 16-day event — but in name only.
Facing a packed schedule, competition in basketball started on Sept. 10 — more than a week ago. The semifinals in men's basketball were on Friday, a day before the official opening.
Soccer has been going on for almost as long. The Summer Olympics typically start a few days early, but this multi-sport event pushes the envelope.
Welcome to the Asian Games, which feature at least 11,000 athletes. The 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris had about 10,700. The last Asian Games in Hangzhou, China, in 2023 had roughly 12,000.
Japanese organizers have yet to release an official athlete total from the 45 countries and regions contesting 43 sports. But it seems likely to reach the total in China of three years ago. Maybe more with a few new sports added.
The games feature the old-standby Olympic disciplines like track and field, swimming and soccer. But there are some Asian specialties, too: kurash, kabaddi, and sepaktakraw to name three.
Kurash is an ancient form of wrestling that originated in Uzbekistan. Kabaddi looks like a game of team tag with a physical edge. And sepaktakraw is a mix of volleyball and soccer.
Games organizers have also added mixed martial arts, padel and teqball to the menu — with esports also on the schedule — hence the time crunch.
Host Japan has the largest delegation with 933 athletes and China came with just over 800. China won 201 gold medals in the last games, followed by Japan (52) and South Korea (42). That pattern is expected to be repeated.
Emperor Naruhito and Empress Masako headed the list of dignitaries. The president of the Olympic Council of Asia, Sheikh Joaan bin Hamad Al Thani, elected earlier this year, was alongside.
“Tonight the eyes of Asia, and much of the world, turn to Japan,” Sheikh Joaan said in his address, which was followed by the Emperor officially opening the games.
The president of the International Olympic Committee, Kirsty Coventry, was also present.
The theme of the opening ceremony was the “Harmonic Heart Beat,” and the stage on the infield at the Nagoya City Stadium was in the shape of a large heart.
Afghanistan led off the traditional parade of athletes with Japan coming in last and, of course, receiving thunderous applause.
The Asian Games have been dotted with controversies in the leadup to the opening ceremony. This also happens in the rush to get ready for most Olympics.
First, there’s the issue of housing for athletes. Japanese organizers decided against building a dedicated athletes village. They opted instead to house an estimated 17,000 athletes and officials on a massive cruise ship, in hotels, and in wooden containers converted to lodging.
Japan officially spent $13 billion on the Tokyo Olympics, delayed until 2021 by the pandemic. A government audit suggested the figure was likely twice that large. So lavish spending was out this time.
Athletes have complained the beds and rooms are too small, some have reported the wooden huts have leaks, and logistics could be an issue with venues spread out around Nagoya.
This is Japan’s third largest metropolitan area with a population of about 9.5 million and located about 200 miles (350 kilometers) south of Tokyo.
Then the inevitable politics. On Friday, the day before the official opening, two incidents made headlines.
Organizers played the North Korean national anthem at a field hockey game between South Korea and Bangladesh. South Korea players stood at attention, bewildered the North Korean anthem was playing.
Many South Koreans are, in fact, unfamiliar with North Korea's anthem and did not know what they were hearing.
At about the same time, Taiwanese sports minister Lee Yang — a two-time Olympic gold medalist in badminton — was temporarily barred from a welcoming ceremony involving Taiwan, and other countries including North Korea, Palestine and India.
The Olympic Council of Asia attributed it to a misunderstanding but did not entirely clarify. Yang was eventually allowed to participate.
Taiwan competes in the Asian Games and the Olympics under the name of Chinese Taipei and without their flag due to China’s claim on the island off its east coast.

title: How a woman’s kidney donation saved her sister – as part of a nationwide transplant chain
content:
Kim Chow says it was not a difficult decision to donate her kidney to a stranger knowing it meant her older sister, Stephanie Chow, would receive one in exchange.
In late July, after months of testing and preparation, the sisters went under the knife in Edmonton’s University of Alberta Hospital. Kim’s surgery was first. Her kidney was removed, quickly placed on ice and airlifted to another province, completing one segment of a transplant chain that stretched across the country.
Five days later, another link was completed when Stephanie was wheeled into an operating room and received a kidney from a living donor outside of Alberta. She will never know who or where the organ came from.
The exchange was made possible through the Kidney Paired Donation Program run by Canadian Blood Services. The program matches potential donor-recipient pairs who are incompatible with each other, such as the Chow sisters, with other such pairs across the country. Patients in need get a healthy kidney – just from a stranger instead of a friend or family member.
Stephanie, 42, said the transplant has changed her life.
Before the surgery, she had been on peritoneal dialysis, a treatment for kidney failure that uses the inner lining of the abdomen to filter blood inside the body. She was diagnosed with an autoimmune disorder as a child that attacked her kidneys until they “crapped out” about two years ago.
“My life was very much determined by when I had to plug into the dialysis machine at night and what time I wanted to wake up. I couldn’t really go anywhere or travel anywhere because the machine I would have to carry, the supplies, is in abundance,” Stephanie said.
She continued: “This kidney is now giving me more flexibility. I feel like I have my life back.”
In Montreal, kidney donors and transplant recipients help put hesitant patients at ease
In 2025, nearly 3,200 organs were transplanted in Canada, 59 per cent of which were kidneys, according to data from the Canadian Institute for Health Information. As of Dec. 31 that year, 4,344 Canadians were on transplant wait-lists, a large proportion for a kidney.
The majority of transplants use organs from deceased donors, since a single body can provide multiple organs. Living donors can only safely give specific organs, such as one of their two kidneys, and must pass strict medical and psychological evaluations.
Stephanie is thankful for being part of the exchange program, not only because it cut down her wait time for a transplant, but because a kidney from a living donor lasts longer and generally provides better outcomes.
The sisters want to raise greater awareness about the program, hoping to help others in Stephanie’s position. “A lot of people have no idea this is an option,” she said.
The paired donation program offers three possible chains, explained transplant nephrologist Michel Paquet, who is a medical adviser to Canadian Blood Services. The first is a paired exchange, where two donor-recipient pairs, or four people, swap kidneys.
Then there is a “closed chain,” where the exchange happens between three or more pairs, usually maxing out at seven, and where the final donor gives a kidney to the first recipient, closing a self-contained loop. Finally, there is an “open chain,” where a sequence of transplants is sparked by an altruistic person who donates a kidney but is not connected to a transplant candidate.
Chains are created using a computerized algorithm and there are three match cycles each year, said Dr. Paquet, who is also the medical director of the living kidney donation program at the University of Montreal Hospital Centre. Since the program began in 2009 – first in Alberta, British Columbia and Ontario before expanding across Canada – it has led to more than 1,300 transplants, he added.
For the first decade, donors had to travel to the recipient’s city to have the surgery. But COVID-19 pushed the program to transport the organs between cities and provinces, helping to expand its reach. More than 400 organs have since been shipped across the country.
One challenge with the program is that the chains are fragile and can collapse if even one person can no longer donate or receive a kidney. However, Dr. Paquet said it’s “pretty rare” for people to simply back out. When that does happen, it’s more often related to medical issues.
Kim, 38, described the program as an exercise in humanity, where emotions are tangled into every decision of an emotionally and physically taxing process.
She began her journey to become a donor in spring 2024, undergoing countless tests – including blood work, urine samples, physical exams, medical questionnaires, X-rays and CT scans – before the surgery took place this summer.
Kim was told that at any point she could back out. For her, that wasn’t an option.
“As a family member, you want to do everything within your power to help your loved one, right? So, even if for whatever reason things didn’t work out, I wanted to know that I had done everything that I could do to help her in that situation.”
Kim did have some worries, such as the long-term impact of having only one kidney and how difficult recovery would be, but none were big enough to sway her from helping her sister.
Postsurgery, their experiences have differed greatly. While a new kidney has given Stephanie a boost of energy and excitement for the future, Kim has been exhausted as her body adapts to having just one kidney. Over time, her organ will expand to take on the workload of two.
The sisters were close before, but the transplant process has brought them even closer together. And it has given Kim a new perspective on what Stephanie endured.
“I don’t think any of us realized exactly how tired she was and how her failing kidney was impacting her life the way that it was,” Kim said. “If she was even half as tired before her transplant as I was coming out of that surgery and healing, I have a lot more empathy for what she went through.”
Stephanie expects to be able to travel again in about a year, when her medical team is certain the donated kidney is performing as it should. She doesn’t know where she’ll go first – maybe Europe or Asia, potentially a river cruise.
It would be nice, she added, to go somewhere with her sister.

title: A Kabul pedalava vestita da uomo, Fariba è argento ai Giochi Asiatici: "Io esempio per le altre"
content:
A Kabul pedalava vestita da uomo per inseguire i propri sogni, capelli cortissimi e caschetto d'ordinanza.
Oggi Fariba Hashimi morde la sua medaglia d'argento ottenuta nella gara di ciclismo femminile ai Giochi Asiatici vicino a Nagoya in Giappone.Tagliando il traguardo in 2 ore, 50 minuti e 5 secondi, battuta in volata dalla cinese Li Guo, racconta la parte più facile della sua storia cominciata quando era ancora adolescente: "Ogni volta che andavo ad allenarmi mi vestivo da uomo coprendomi il volto per non essere riconosciuta”. E quando andava male "mi aggredivano lanciandomi pietre".
Poi nel 2021, anno di svolta per l'Afghanistan col ritorno al potere dei Talebani, ha deciso di lasciare il suo paese caduto nell'oscurità dei diritti umani e civili negati alle donne. "Sono fuggita perché volevo inseguire il mio sogno" dice l'atleta. Allora fu decisivo l'aiuto dell'ex campionessa del mondo Alessandra Cappellotto.
Hashimi, originaria di Faryab, una provincia nel nord dell'Afghanistan, riuscì, con la sorella Yulduz anche lei ciclista professionista, a salire su un aereo che decollava dall'aeroporto di Kabul in fiamme, per arrivare in Italia, dove da allora vive e si allena. Ma spiega: "Non ho una squadra, sono il meccanico della mia bici, e si augura che "la prossima generazione venga qui a rappresentare il mio Paese senza alcuna paura". Abbiamo visto le due sorelle in gara già a Parigi 2024.
"Ci hanno tolto la libertà, ci hanno portato via tutto", ma afferma con una punta d'orgoglio "questa medaglia d'argento dimostra la resilienza delle donne afgane. Non mi sento sola; so che dietro di me ci sono milionidi donne, di molti paesi, che condividono gli stessi sogni e sono al mio fianco". Secondo gli ultimi dati Unicef, in Afghanistan oltre 2,2 milioni di ragazze sono attualmente escluse dall'istruzione, e solo il 4,8% - 6% lavora. Restrizioni che si inseriscono in un sistema di totale esclusione delle donne dalla vita pubblica, lavorativa e sociale, spesso definito come un vero e proprio "apartheid di genere".
"Ogni volta che andavo ad allenarmi", racconta, "mi vestivo da uomo". “Mi coprivo il volto per non essere riconosciuta”. E quando andava male "mi colpivano lanciandomi pietre"
Fariba Hashimi
La 23enne campionessa su due ruote ha dimenticato per un momento l'angoscia del passato: "Sono davvero felicissima ed emozionata. Non so come spiegarlo a parole", ha detto. "Spero un giorno di tornare nel mio Paese e pedalare libera per le strade di Kabul, fianco a fianco con altre donne, condividendo la stessa passione", ha spiegato.
"Spero che in futuro le cose cambino, siamo davvero stanche della situazione nel nostro Paese e spero che i talebani ci stiano guardando. So quanto possa essere potente una donna, ed è per questo che i talebani hanno paura delle donne", ha affermato Hashimi.
I dati delle Nazioni Unite, dell’UNESCO e dell’UNICEF raccontano una storia ancora lontana fatta di privazioni e violenze, della profonda crisi umanitaria ed economica in cui versa la popolazione afgana più giovane privata del suo futuro. Per Hashimi e sua sorella, invece, scampate al regime, ci saranno le Olimpiadi di Los Angeles del 2028.

title: Kela | Joka kolmas vuonna 1997 syntynyt nainen on saanut mielen­terveyteen liittyvää etuutta
content:
Joka kolmas vuonna 1997 syntynyt nainen on 28 vuoden ikään mennessä saanut mielenterveyteen tai neurokirjoon liittyvää sairauspäivärahaa, työkyvyttömyyseläkettä tai kuntoutuspsykoterapiaa. Miehistä vastaava osuus on noin joka seitsemäs, ilmenee Kelan tekemästä tuoreesta tarkastelusta.
Kelan tutkijat selvittivät, kuinka suuri osa vuonna 1997 syntyneistä oli saanut näitä etuuksia tai kuntoutuspsykoterapiaa 16 vuoden iästä vuoden 2025 loppuun mennessä.
Tarkastelu kuvasi ensimmäistä kertaa sitä, miten suurelle osalle yhdestä ikäluokasta etuuksia kertyi nuoruuden ja varhaisen aikuisuuden aikana.
Naisista 33,9 prosenttia ja miehistä 15,3 prosenttia oli saanut vähintään yhtä tarkastelluista etuuksista tai kuntoutuspsykoterapiaa.
Mielenterveysperusteista sairauspäivärahaa oli saanut 25 prosenttia naisista ja 12 prosenttia miehistä. Kuntoutuspsykoterapiaa oli saanut 16 prosenttia naisista ja alle 4 prosenttia miehistä.
”Julkinen keskustelu keskittyy usein yksittäisten palvelujen ja etuuksien ympärille, mutta meidän on tärkeää ymmärtää, kuinka suurista väestötason ilmiöistä ylipäätään puhumme”, Kelan tutkimuspäällikkö Miika Vuori sanoo tiedotteessa.
Vuori huomauttaa lisäksi, että viranomaisrekisterit mittaavat etuuksien ja palveluiden käyttöä, eivät suoraan mielenterveyttä tai sen haasteita.
”Erityisen huomionarvoista on, kuinka yleistä kuntoutuspsykoterapian käyttö oli nuorten naisten elämässä. Toisaalta myös suuri ero miehiin nähden herättää kysymyksiä”, hän toteaa.
Määräaikaista tai pysyvää työkyvyttömyyseläkettä sai 3,5 prosenttia naisista ja 3,4 prosenttia miehistä. Työkyvyttömyyseläkettä saaneiden osuudet olivat siis lähes samat, vaikka sairauspäivärahassa ja kuntoutuspsykoterapiassa sukupuolierot olivat suuria.
Työkyvyttömyyseläkkeiden taustalla olevissa diagnooseissa oli kuitenkin selvä ero. Älylliseen kehitysvammaisuuteen tai neurokehitykselliseen oireyhtymään liittyvä diagnoosi sisältyi eläkkeen perusteisiin 62 prosentilla miehistä ja 37 prosentilla naisista.
Kelan kartoituksessa olivat mukana kaikki Suomessa vuonna 1997 syntyneet tarkastelun aikana elossa olleet. Aineistossa oli runsaat 28 000 naista ja runsaat 29 000 miestä.

추석 맞아 전통시장·골목상권 활력 기대
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(남해=연합뉴스) 박정헌 기자 = 경남에서 유일하게 농어촌 기본소득 시범사업을 도입한 남해군이 추석 연휴를 맞아 이러한 기본소득이 지역 경기 부양에 더 활력을 불어넣을 것으로 기대한다.
25일 남해군에 따르면 올해 1월부터 시행된 농어촌 기본소득 지급액은 7월 말 기준 총 386억원에 달했다.
이 중 294억원이 실제 사용돼 76.1%의 높은 사용률을 기록했다.
업종별 사용 현황을 보면 군민들의 실생활과 밀접한 소비가 주를 이뤘다.
음식점업이 26.3%(77억4천600만원)로 가장 높았고, 편의점·슈퍼·마트 등 유통업이 16.8%(49억3천200만원), 의료·보건 13.4%(39억5천100만원), 주유소 11.3%(33억2천200만원) 등 순으로 나타났다.
특히 일반가맹점 외에도 병원·약국·학원 등 공통 가맹점과 주유소 등에서 고르게 자금이 도는 것으로 분석됐다.
초기에는 식료품이나 생필품 등 필수 생계비 위주로 소비되던 자금이 제도가 안착하면서 점차 체육·문화·여가 등 평소 지출을 망설였던 분야로 확산하는 경향도 엿보이고 있다.
매월 정기적으로 풀리는 15만원의 지역 재원이 농어촌 지역의 기초적인 경제 순환을 지탱하는 마중물 역할을 하는 셈이다.
이 같은 흐름은 이번 추석 명절을 맞아 더욱 탄력을 받을 것으로 기대된다.
명절 장보기와 선물 구입 등 가계의 경제적 부담을 덜어주고 명절 소비로 이어져 전통시장 활성화와 가족·이웃 간 공동체 회복에 활력을 불어넣을 것으로 전망된다.
평소 대형유통업체나 온라인으로 향하던 소비 발길을 지역 내 전통시장과 골목상권으로 돌리는 효과를 낸다는 전망이다.
또 명절을 맞아 고향을 찾은 귀성객들과 주민들이 지역 상점에서 함께 장을 보고 어울리는 과정에서 유대감이 더 강해지고 지역 상권의 유동성이 높아지는 효과도 나타날 수 있다.
다만 단기적인 경기 부양 효과를 넘어 인구 구조 변화와 지속 가능한 지역 소멸 대응 효과를 정확히 검증하기 위해서는 최소 5년 이상의 객관적 데이터 확보가 필요하다는 제언도 나온다.
군 관계자는 "농어촌 기본소득이 지역 주민들의 가계 부담을 덜고 소상공인들의 매출 증대로 이어지는 등 긍정적 파급효과를 내고 있다"며 "이번 추석 명절이 지역 경제에 활력을 불어넣는 중요한 전환점이 되기를 기대한다"고 말했다.

title: Y así fue como tres amigas que veraneaban juntas fundaron un festival de cortos en un pueblo de Cádiz
content: Conil de Cine celebra su tercera edición con caras conocidas del séptimo arte como Ingrid García-Jonsson o Ruth Gabriel y una experiencia inmersiva en una iglesia del siglo XVII Las historias de verano tienen a veces estos desenlaces: tres amigas se conocen en un pueblo de playa, el tiempo pasa y los cariños se consolidan, hasta que un buen día deciden embarcarse juntas en una aventura. Por ejemplo, la creación de un festival de cine. Esa sería, de forma muy resumida, la peripecia fundacional del Festival Internacional de Cortometrajes Conil de Cine, una cita que lleva ya dos ediciones en continuo crecimiento, y que celebrará la tercera del 24 al 27 de septiembre. La actriz Raquel Guerrero, natural de Carabanchel, se alió así con las conileñas Isabel Sánchez y Noelia Muñoz para dar forma a lo que empezó siendo una ocurrencia más o menos extravagante, y que ha acabado convirtiéndose en una realidad. “Queríamos hacer algo juntas, y en concreto aquí. Conil es un municipio muy centrado en el turismo, y pensamos que podía posicionarse de otra manera, a través de la cultura”, explica Guerrero, en un espléndido momento de su carrera tras protagonizar la serie Machos alfa. “En el fondo, es una forma de cariño hacia un sitio que adoramos, aportar algo a un sitio que nos ha visto crecer”. Eso aunque, como comenta la propia actriz, “es un jaleo, ya que ahora mismo estoy rodando en Tenerife, mis compañeras tienen también sus obligaciones... Pero nos organizamos entre las tres”. Algo que queda patente viendo la programación de este año, que reunirá este año a un buen número de profesionales y caras conocidas del séptimo arte y de la televisión como Ingrid García-Jonsson, Ana Wagener, Ruth Gabriel, Raúl Tejón, Emilio Buale, Antonio Pagudo, Norma Ruiz, Nacho Fresneda y Raquel Guerrero, entre otros. Cine quinqui Asimismo, la programación profesional contará con figuras como el director Joaquín Mazón, que impartirá la clase magistral El arte de dirigir comedias, y con profesionales de referencia de la industria como Rosa Estévez, Alejandro Gil (Lane Casting), Marichu Sanz, Isa Sánchez, Néstor López, Merche Herranz (La Zona) o Aitor Arenas Suso. “Una de las secciones a las que más cariño les tengo y que queremos mantener es la que dedicamos al cine quinqui, con referentes como Deprisa, deprisa o Los golfos”, añade Guerrero. Toda la programación, sección oficial, horarios, actividades profesionales y proyecciones pueden consultarse en la web oficial de la cita, www.conildecine.com, donde el público puede reservar plaza para las masterclasses y encuentros y adquirir directamente sus entradas. Entre los títulos que se proyectarán en versión oficial, destacan títulos como No estás loca, de María Bestar; Ser un hombre, de Lucas Parra; María Rita, de Juan Barbazán; I walked through the Wall, de Pablo Larcuen; Pichu es así, de Carmen Córdoba; El ressó de la mirada y Loquita por ti, de Greta Díaz; Pobre Marciano, de Alex Rey; Cara de cona, de Guillermo de Oliveira; Polígono X, de Néstor López; Mi juego, de David Navarro; o La conversación que nunca tuvimos, de Cristina Urgel, entre otros. Por su parte, la Sección Oficial internacional reunirá cintas como The first patrol, de Vojtech Jonecny (República Checa); Nun, de Ekaterina Kuznetsova (República Checa); Khazan (Treasure) de Basir Ahmed (Pakistán); o Dans l’isoloir (Inside the Booth), de Baptiste Martin-Bonnaire (Francia). Patrimonio y tecnología No obstante, la gran novedad de este año será la incorporación de un templo del siglo XVI como espacio de proyección del festival. La histórica iglesia de Santa Catalina se convertirá en un atractivo añadido para los asistentes a Conil de Cine, que vivirán una experiencia inmersiva. Según adelanta la organización, las películas se proyectarán sobre una gran pantalla instalada en el espacio, mientras que cada espectador dispondrá de auriculares individuales para escuchar directamente el sonido de la película. “Una forma de exhibición que busca modificar la relación habitual entre el público y la pantalla: escuchar cada diálogo con nitidez, percibir cada silencio y sumergirse en el universo sonoro de cada película mientras se comparte, al mismo tiempo, la emoción de una experiencia colectiva”, comentan. Según las impulsoras del festival, los apoyos han ido sumándose año tras año: “El Ayuntamiento se implicó desde el primer momento, luego pudimos contar con la ayuda de la Diputación de Cádiz, y este año, además de Fundación La Caixa, hemos recibido también la ayuda de la Fundación Cajasol como patrocinador. Pero sobre todo se ha volcado el pueblo, que ha venido respaldando con su presencia el festival y nos proporciona muchos apoyos locales. En buena medida, porque los cines Moreno, que eran los últimos que quedaban en Conil, ya no existen, pero los espectadores siguen queriendo vivir la experiencia del cine en pantalla grande”. Para Raquel Guerrero, Conil de Cine es el modo de conectar su profesión con este rincón de la costa gaditana, conocido por la industria conservera y el ocio estival, pero también de arraigarse ella misma, un poco más, al espacio en el que ha sido feliz desde muy niña. “Conocí el pueblo cuando estaba apenas arrancando, ¡no había ni bares! Todo ha cambiado mucho, pero sigue siendo mi segunda casa. Siempre lo digo: si me pierdo, buscadme en Conil”.

title: Udi Christians worship at Azerbaijan's Karabakh monasteries
content:
A religious service at the historic Gandzasar monastery has offered a rare insight into Karabakh’s Christian heritage, as historic religious disputes linger while Azerbaijan and Armenia work toward lasting peace.
With peace returning to the region, Azerbaijan’s Udi Christians continue their centuries-old practice of pilgrimage and prayer at Karabakh’s historic Christian sites, as Azerbaijan showcases the preservation of religious sites whose historical identity remains contested.
For local communities and officials, these sites mean more than religious practice, as they project the safeguarding of Christian identity in the region.
As part of a government programme to explore the region’s Christian heritage and religious traditions, Euronews and other media outlets met a congregation of Udi Christians for their religious service at the ancient monastery of Gandzasar, near Vangli village in Azerbaijan’s Aghdara district, and talked to representatives involved in the preservation and maintenance of the site.
Prince Hasan-Jalal Dawla built the monastery’s main church between 1216 and 1238. Azerbaijan identifies it with the Caucasian Albanian Christian tradition, while Armenia identifies it with the Armenian Apostolic one, as competing interpretations continue to challenge the historic peace process between the two countries.
The Udi people are an indigenous, predominantly Christian ethnic group in Azerbaijan, primarily based in the village of Nij.
For the pilgrims, returning to Gandzasar represents restoring a deep historical link.
"Today, thanks to the acquisition of independence, we are in the monastery built by our holy fathers. We are proud of our history," said Danakari Rafiq Arami, Deputy Chairman of the Alban-Udi Christian Community, emphasising the emotional weight of holding a service in the native Udi language.
Azerbaijan’s Udi community make pilgrimages to historic Christian sites associated with their heritage, including other monasteries in the Karabakh region, such as Khudavang, Ağoğlan and Amaras, which Azerbaijan identifies as historic Christian sites in Karabakh in its preservation programme.
Khudavang is located in the Kalbajar district, while Ağoğlan Monastery is in the Lachin district and Amaras Monastery is in the Khojavend district.
Christianity has a long history on the territory of present-day Azerbaijan, which prides itself on the peaceful coexistence of Muslims, Christians and Jews. UNESCO’s documentation on the Historic Centre of Sheki states that Christianity was introduced in the region as early as the 1st century CE.
One of the principal sites associated with this history is the church at Kish, near Sheki. The wider Udi Christian legacy is also represented in Nij, in the Gabala district, where the Udi community continues to practise Christianity.
The media visit comes shortly after a diplomatic delegation visited Gandzasar and Khudavang monasteries on 12 September.
Representatives of the diplomatic corps accredited in Azerbaijan were briefed on the history and architecture of the sites, as well as Azerbaijan’s claims about alterations to the monuments, which ignited a row with Armenia over the sites’ heritage and identity.
EU Special Representative for the South Caucasus Magdalena Grono, who took part in the diplomatic visit, said there were still "deeply divergent views and narratives" concerning the origins of some sites.
Grono stressed the importance of addressing unresolved historical disputes as part of the broader reconciliation process.

title: Youth-Led Forest Restoration Movement Traces Back to a 9-Year-Old’s Question About Climate Change
content:
A boy who learned about Wangari Maathai’s tree-planting legacy at age nine sparked a youth-led forest restoration movement now training over 100,000 young Climate Justice Ambassadors across 76 countries.
Youth-led forest restoration at Plant-for-the-Planet began in 2007, when nine-year-old Felix Finkbeiner in Germany learned about Kenyan Nobel laureate Wangari Maathai’s campaign planting 30 million trees across Africa. Struck by her message that trees serve as powerful allies against global warming, Finkbeiner proposed that every country commit to planting one million trees. By age 13, he stood before the United Nations General Assembly, raising that ambition to one trillion trees worldwide.
Nearly two decades later, youth-led forest restoration has grown from one child’s conviction into a global movement operating academies across 76 countries. More than 104,800 children and youth have become Climate Justice Ambassadors, trained to understand the climate crisis and empowered to fight for their future through tree planting, public speaking, and community organizing. The organization has facilitated more than 36 million trees planted directly through its own restoration projects, while its platform has funded over 107 million trees through partner organizations worldwide.
The model driving youth-led forest restoration rests on a simple premise: young people affected most by climate change deserve genuine agency in addressing it, not token participation. At Plant-for-the-Planet Academies, Ambassadors learn climate science, then apply that knowledge locally, giving speeches, organizing tree-planting events, and mobilizing their communities. This youth leadership extends into formal governance through the Global Ambassadors Council, the organization’s official youth leadership body shaping strategic direction.
Restoration work spans three countries, each addressing distinct ecological challenges. In Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula, youth-led forest restoration protects and regrows Mayan rainforest, with more than 17.8 million trees planted, two reserves under active patrol, and work underway establishing a jaguar wildlife corridor connecting fragmented habitat. In Ghana, community-based restoration addresses degradation across the Savannah Ecological Zone, tackling climate vulnerability and poverty simultaneously through Plant-for-Ghana. In Spain, restoration projects are reviving lost forest landscapes around Granada, Doñana, Madrid, and Barcelona.
Beyond planting trees directly, youth-led forest restoration extends its impact through free technology supporting restoration organizations worldwide. Forest Cloud provides funding, management, and monitoring tools for restoration projects at no cost to nonprofits and communities, and has already enabled more than 100 million trees to be funded through the platform. FireAlert monitors 1.6 billion hectares for wildfire risk, allowing rapid response before fires spread. TreeMapper helps organizations track restoration progress with scientific rigor, while SeedManager, still in development, will support biodiverse ecosystem restoration specifically.
This technology-sharing approach reflects a deliberate strategic shift. Rather than measuring success purely by trees planted, satellite imagery and hectare-based tracking now anchor the organization’s accountability, providing longer-term verification of genuine forest recovery rather than short-term planting counts alone. Free restoration advice and published research further extend support to restoration organizations beyond Plant-for-the-Planet’s own direct projects.
Youth-led forest restoration also encompasses direct policy advocacy. The organization pushes for policies enabling forest conservation and climate justice, including transparency initiatives like TFFF Watch, which monitors accountability within international rainforest funding mechanisms, and Tracer, a tool supporting deforestation-free supply chains under European Union regulations.
National entities extend this youth-led forest restoration model across eight countries with independent operations. Ghana’s affiliate has empowered 2,400 Climate Justice Ambassadors while planting over 227,000 trees. Spain’s chapter, active since 2013, has trained over 5,100 Ambassadors through 151 academies while planting more than 501,000 trees. Since 2015, Czechia has mobilized youth and national celebrities alike, engaging over 1,000 Ambassadors. Each national entity adapts the core model, youth empowerment paired with forest restoration, to its own climate and community context.
Corporate partnerships increasingly fund this expansion. Companies can grow dedicated forest plots, support deforestation-free supply chains, and educate their workforce on climate action through structured partnership programs. Change Chocolate, a fair-trade product line, generates revenue that directly supports community forest protection in tropical regions vulnerable to deforestation pressure.
What distinguishes youth-led forest restoration from conventional reforestation charities is this persistent emphasis on intergenerational leadership. Ambassadors don’t simply volunteer for adult-designed programs; they shape strategy through elected councils, speak at international forums, and carry restoration knowledge into their own communities as they grow into adulthood. Finkbeiner himself, once a nine-year-old inspired by a Nobel laureate’s tree-planting campaign, now leads an organization where the next generation of nine-year-olds continues that same cycle of learning and action.
Nearly twenty years after one child’s question about climate change reached a global stage, youth-led forest restoration demonstrates that meaningful climate action doesn’t require waiting for adulthood or institutional permission. It requires forests, young people willing to fight for them, and the tools to turn that determination into hectares of restored, thriving ecosystems.

title: Ras för valdeltagandet längs riksväg 62 i norra Värmland
content:
Ras för valdeltagandet längs riksväg 62 i norra Värmland
Samtidigt som valdeltagandet ökade i flera av städernas utsatta områden minskade det kraftigt i glesbygden i norra Värmland.
I Stöllet struntade nästan hälften av invånarna i att rösta i kommunvalet.
– Det blev bara inte så, säger Pernilla Halvardsson som var en av dem som stannade hemma.
När rösterna räknats i valdistrikten längs riksväg 62 i norra Värmland talar siffrorna sitt tydliga språk.
I Sysslebäck längst i norr minskade valdeltagandet i riksdagsvalet med 7,3 procentenheter. I Stöllet en bit söderut med 10,2.
Rashotade riksväg 62
I kommunvalet var raset ännu större. Bara 55,1 procent av Stölletborna valde att rösta.
– Jag skulle väl ha röstat men jag kom aldrig iväg, säger Stölletbon Pernilla Halvarsson.
Känsla av utanförskap
SVT har tidigare rapporterat om den rashotade riksvägen och den känsla av utanförskap som vuxit i samhällena längs vägen.
De senaste 30 åren har befolkningen minskat med mer än 40 procent. I dag bor bara knappt 3 000 personer i Klarälvens norra dalgång.
Madelene Cisek, som är rektor på bygdens två kvarvarande skolor, är orolig för utvecklingen.
– Människor måste få engagera sig och känna att det faktiskt kan leda till att det händer något konkret. Om man inte känner det faller det mesta, säger hon.
Ingen teori om orsak
Norra Värmland var ett av flera glesbygdsområden i landet där valdeltagandet var lågt redan i det förra valet.
När det nu slås nya rekord står politikerna frågande inför utvecklingen.
– Jag har ingen teori om vad det beror på, Jag vet faktiskt inte, säger kommunalrådet i Torsby kommun, Peter Jonsson (S).
I videon ovan berättar Peter Jonsson vad han tror händer om utvecklingen fortsätter.
Så arbetar vi
SVT:s nyheter ska stå för saklighet och opartiskhet. Det vi publicerar ska vara sant och relevant. Vid akuta nyhetslägen kan det vara svårt att få alla fakta bekräftade, då ska vi berätta vad vi vet – och inte vet. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar.

title: Kallada Jalotsavam to be held on September 23
content:
The 54th Kallada Jalotsavam and the second leg of the 6th Champions Boat League (CBL), organised by the State Tourism department, will be held on the Kallada river on Wednesday (September 23, 2026), said Ullas Kovoor, MLA, during a press meet held here on Saturday.
Tracing its roots back 53 years, the Kallada Jalotsavam originally commenced near the railway bridge close to the Veerabhadraswamy temple. However, the event had to be temporarily suspended due to the 2018 floods and the COVID-19 pandemic. Although the CBL resumed after the pandemic, small boat competitions were omitted, which gradually reduced local community participation. Subsequently, in 2024, Mundrothuruthu grama panchayat and the Kallada Jalotsavam Committee successfully revived the traditional festival on the 28th day of Onam, with the Jalotsavam and the CBL initially being held on separate days.
Later, Kodikunnil Suresh, MP, and Mr. Kovoor held discussions with Minister for Tourism and Culture P.C. Vishnunadh, leading to a decision to merge both events on the 28th day of Onam. Following this, collaborative meetings involving the Tourism department, the Kallada Jalotsavam Committee, representatives from three local grama panchayats in Kallada, boat club officials, and political party members finalised the joint hosting. Marking a milestone for the event, nine snakeboats (chundan vallam) that triumphed in the Nehru Trophy Boat Race alongside over 15 small traditional boats (veppu and iruttukuthi categories) will participate in the competition, making it the highest number of racing boats ever gathered on the Kallada river.
The function will be inaugurated by Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala. Mr. Kovoor will preside over the event. Mr. Vishnunadh will grace the occasion as the chief guest, while Mr. Suresh will distribute the prizes to the winners.

title: Javult a lombikkezelések eredményessége, de több intézet így is jóval az országos átlag alatt teljesít
content:
Újabb, a szakma és a páciensek által is régóta várt eredményességi mutatókat publikált az állami lombikintézetek szakmai irányításáért felelős Humánreprodukciós Igazgatóság (HRI). Elemzésükben most először közöltek hivatalos adatokat arról, melyik magyarországi lombikcentrumban mekkora sikeraránnyal dolgoznak.
Eszerint bár az országos átlagok tavaly javultak, „az intézetek közötti szórás tetemes”, és több centrum jóval az országos átlag alatt teljesít.
Igaz, ennek az összehasonlításnak bőven vannak korlátai – de erről majd később.
Magyarországon az Orbán-kormány 2022-ben államosította az asszisztált reprodukciós centrumokat (ezeket a köznyelv annak ellenére hívja lombikintézeteknek, hogy nem csak lombikkezeléseket végeznek). A meglévő magáncentrumok közül többet megvásárolt, a többinek pedig, melyekre az állam nem tett ajánlatot, be kellett zárnia. Az Európai Bizottság ugyan kötelezettszegési eljárást indított, az ügy egyelőre még nem zárult le, az EU Bíróságára vár.
A Humánreprodukciós Intézetet ugyanebben az évben hozták létre, 2025-ig Vesztergom Dóra vezette, azóta Várnagy Ákos felelős a területért. A kormány, majd a HRI rengeteg változást vezetett be az ágazatban. Először ingyenessé tették a kezeléseket, majd a finanszírozáson és az eljárásokon is változtattak, ezekről ebben a cikkünkben bővebben is írtunk:
https://hvg.hu/itthon/20231026_igy_modositana_tovabb_a_lombikkezelesek_szabalyait_a_kormany
Szintén kulcsfontosságú változás volt, hogy létrehozták a Nemzeti Humánregisztrációs Regisztert, mely 2024 januárjától az EESZT-vel összekötve pontos képet ad a 13 állami intézetben végzett beavatkozásokról. Ez alapján meg lehet mondani, hány páciensen hány beavatkozást végeztek, és ami még ennél is fontosabb: közölni tudják a becsült kumulatív születési rátát. A meddőségi szakmában a kumulatív születési ráta az egyik legfontosabb adat: egy évre vetítve mutatja meg az asszisztált reprodukciós eljárásokból történt szülések és az adott időszak alatt történt petesejtleszívások arányát. Ezt a mutatót tartják a legmegbízhatóbbnak az eredményesség megállapításához, és ezt használja az Európai Humán Reprodukciós és Embriológiai Társaság (ESHRE) is a nemzetközi összehasonlításokhoz.
Bár az intézeteknek már régóta kötelező adatszolgáltatást írtak elő, ezek hiányosak voltak, így a számokat hosszú évekig nem publikálták. Ez a regiszter bevezetése után két évvel, idén februárban változott meg.
https://hvg.hu/360/20260205_sikeressegi-rata-magyarorszagi-lombikklinikak-humanreprodukcios-igazgatosag
Eszerint 2024-ben a becsült kumulatív élveszülés Magyarországon 26,4 százalékos volt, vagyis az elvégzett petefészek-stimulációkból (ez a lombikeljárás első lépése) ilyen arányban született gyermek.
Ez a szám alacsonyabb az európainál: az ESHRE 2020-as számai szerint az adatokat szolgáltató országokban a sikerességi arány átlag 32,3 százalék volt. Ez ugyanakkor megtévesztő lehet, hiszen Magyarországon 45 éves korig engedélyezett az állami, saját petesejttel végzett lombik, ami jelentősen ront a hazai számokon – a legtöbb országban 40 év ez a korhatár, és minél idősebb korban végzik a beavatkozást, annál kisebb a sikerre az esély.
A Humánreprodukciós Intézetet korábban sok kritika érte, mert az országos sikerességi rátát ugyan közzétette, az egyes intézetekét azonban nem. Így a magyar párok – akiknek 17 százaléka küzd meddőséggel – nem tudhatják, melyik intézményhez forduljanak a meglévő 13-ból, ha nagyobb eséllyel szeretnének indulni a szülővé válás útján. Ezt Várnagy Ákos, a HRI vezetője a HVG-nek adott interjúban azzal magyarázta, hogy a beteganyag és az eljárások minden intézményben folyamatosan változnak. „Nem látom annak értelmét, hogy ezek az adatok úgy kerüljenek ki, hogy nem tesszük mellé azt, hogy ez egy pillanatnyi állapot” – mondta akkor.
https://hvg.hu/360/20260227_varnagy-akos-humanreprodukcios-igazgatosag-meddoseg-petesejtdonacio-interju
A múlt héten végül mégis megjelent a régóta várt összehasonlító elemzés, mely a 2024-2025. évi eredményességi mutatók alapján készült.
Javuló eredményesség, kevesebb beteg
A 16 oldalas dokumentum nemcsak azt vizsgálja, hogyan teljesítettek az egyes intézetek, hanem az új, országos eredményeket is közzéteszi. Eszerint 2024-hez képest 2025-ben a magyar intézetekben enyhén csökkent a betegforgalom és a petesejt-leszívások száma is, de a terhességi arány emelkedett. Ez rendszerszintű minőségi változást jelent.
Érdekesség, hogy az elemzés elkészítéséhez két csoportot használtak. Az egyik az összes beteget figyelembe veszi, a másik viszont csak egy meghatározott referenciacsoport. Az utóbbi kritériumai a 25-36 év közötti életkor, a legalább 6 leszívott petesejt és a műtéti spermiumkinyerés nélkül végzett megtermékenyítés voltak. Erre azért volt szükség, mert a betegállományban területileg és intézetenként is nagy különbségek lehetnek. Ilyen például, ha egy budapesti intézetbe a szokásosnál több 40 év feletti páciens, vagy komolyabb egészségügyi problémákkal küzdő pár érkezik, az ő esélyeik lényegesen rosszabbak lehetnek, ami kihat az eredményekre is. A referenciacsoport alkalmazása könnyebbé tette az intézetek összehasonlítását, de nem szüntet meg minden különbséget – írták a készítők.
A mellékelt táblázat szerint az eredményesség mindkét csoportban javult. A teljes betegállományban friss embriótranszfereknél 2,02 százalékponttal, fagyasztott embriótranszfereknél pedig 3,15 százalékkal. A referenciacsoportban ennél is jobbak lettek az eredmények, itt az emelkedés 2,77 és 3,11 százalékos, vagyis itt már 35 és 31,5 százalék felett az eredményesség.
(A friss embriótranszfer (ET) azt jelenti, hogy a mesterséges megtermékenyítés után az embriót még ugyanabban a ciklusban visszaültetik a méhbe, a fagyasztott embriótranszfer (FET) esetében viszont az embriót lefagyasztják, és egy későbbi időpontban ültetik be, amikor optimálisabbak erre a körülmények.)
Ennek okát a szakemberek a finanszírozási és jogszabályi változásokban látják, például abban, hogy előnyben részesítik az ötnapos embriók beültetését, és gyakrabban használnak fagyasztott embriókat (utóbbi beavatkozás gyakrabban jár sikerrel), valamint eltörölték azt is, hogy két beültetés között kötelezően három hónapot kell várni.
Kiemelték ugyanakkor hogy a meddőségi ellátásban felülreprezentáltak a 35 év feletti nők, ez a jelenség nem igazán változott az elmúlt években. Mivel a KSH adatai szerint a szülőkorú nők száma folyamatosan csökken, nem zárják ki, hogy hosszabb távon ennek hatása lesz a meddőségi ellátásban részt vevők számára is.
Hatalmas különbségek
Miközben a sikeresség úgy tűnik, javul, az elemzés készítői azt is elismerik, hogy óriási különbségek vannak a különböző intézmények eredményei között. Az eltéréseket ők két külön forrásra vezetik vissza:
- az egyik, hogy egy intézetbe kik járnak, mennyire idősek, milyen az egészségi állapotuk és mi a meddőség oka. Ez nehezen kontrollálható adottság.
- a másikon már lehet változtatni. Ide tartozik az infrastruktúra, a labor felszereltsége, az épület állapota, az eszközpark kora, az alkalmazott technika vagy épp a személyzet tapasztalata és képzettsége.
Úgy tudjuk, hogy a különböző intézetek a nemrég megkapott adatok alapján elkezdték egymás között megosztani a tapasztalataikat, ettől is remélve, hogy kiegyensúlyozottabb lesz az eredményesség. Hogy valóban van mit javítani, az látszik a közzétett adatokból is. Míg a 13-ból 8 intézet jobban teljesít az országos átlagnál, több is jelentősen lemaradt.
Ha a friss embriótranszferekre vetített terhességi arányokat nézzük, akkor a referenciacsoportban a legjobb eredménye a Győri Intézetnek, a SOTE ARO-nak és a SOTE ARC-nak (mindkettő budapesti), a legrosszabb pedig a Kútvölgyi, a Kaposvári és az Angyalföldi Intézetnek van.
Ugyanez fagyasztott embriótranszferekre vetítve a SOTE ARO, Győr és Szeged esetében hozta a legjobb eredményeket, rosszabbul a Kútvölgyi, Kaposvár és Pécs teljesített.
Itt kell azonban megjegyezni, hogy a Gazdagréti, az Angyalföldi, a Kaposvári Intézetekben és a SOTE ARO-ban lényegesen több 41 év feletti pácienst látnak el, mint máshol, ami ronthat az eredményességen.
A referenciacsoportban 2125-ben friss embriók beültetésénél a terhességi arány 2025-ben országosan 35,03 százalékos volt. Ebben a csoportban a legrosszabbul a Kútvölgyi Intézet teljesített (23,4%), a legjobban pedig Győr (50,4%).
A fagyasztott embriótranszferek esetében is nagy a szórás. Itt a tavalyi országos terhességi arány 31,5 % volt. Ehhez képest Kaposváron csak 13,2%, míg a SOTE Asszisztált Reprodukciós Osztályán 53,6%.
A becsült kumulatív élveszülés adatai egyelőre még csak 2024-ből vannak meg, de már ennek is létezik intézményi bontása, ami így néz ki:
Itt a legjobb eredmények Győrben születtek. Fontos azonban, hogy az intézeti százalékok megítélését befolyásolják az esetszámok, a kisebb forgalmú centrumokban ugyanis egyetlen sikeres vagy sikertelen beavatkozás is több százalékponttal mozdíthatja el az éves arányt.
Hol marad a petesejt-donáció?
Várnagy Ákos, a HRI vezetője a Magyar Kórházszövetség siófoki kongresszusán is megismételte, hogy a nemzetközi összevetésben gyengébb magyar adatok egyik fő oka a petesejt-donáció hazai hiánya. Ezzel kapcsolatban már elkészítették a lehetőség megnyitásával kapcsolatos javaslatukat, „amely összhangban van a szakmai konszenzussal”.
A donáció engedélyezését nagyon régóta várja a szakma, és lényegében nincs olyan, aki ne értene vele egyet. Olyannyira, hogy tavaly az Orbán-kormány be is nyújtotta az erről szóló törvényjavaslatot, de annak megszavazását váratlanul elhalasztották, azóta pedig nincs haladás a témában. Hegedűs Zsolt, a Tisza-kormány egészségügyi miniszter megígérte, hogy átvizsgálják a rendszert, de hogy erre mikor kerül sor, nem tudni.

title: Šiauliai gimtadienį pasitiko bėgimu: miesto gatvėse – šimtai dalyvių
content:
Šiauliai švenčia 790-ąjį miesto gimtadienį – jis minimas Saulės mūšio dieną. Miesto bendruomenę subūrė visą dieną vykusi bėgimo šventė. Nuo ryto simbolines kelių šimtų metrų atkarpas bėgo darželinukai, po pietų – vyresnieji.
Jie turėjo įveikti „šiaulietiškąją mylią“ – simbolinę 1236 metrų distanciją, žyminčią Saulės mūšio metus. Suaugusieji gali bėgti 5 ar 10 kilometrų atkarpą arba pusmaratonį – kiek daugiau nei 21 kilometrą.
Antradienį minima ir Diena be automobilio. Miesto autobusai keleivius veža nemokamai. Vakare Šiauliuose vyko autobuso stūmimo rungtis.
„Aš manyčiau, bus arti kokių 7000 per dieną. Nepamirškim, startuojam 10 [valandą], paskutinis bėgimas – 7 vakare. Džiugu, kad bendruomenė įsitraukia, kad noriai dalyvauja. Palinkėsiu visiems organizatoriams ir tai pačiai savivaldybei neprarasti noro ir užauginti Šiauliuose tikrai aukšto lygio bėgimą“, – pažymi vienas iš Šiaulių bėgimo organizatorių Justinas Beržanskis.
„Mes su vaikais pirmą kartą bėgam. Vaikams patiko bėgti. Kaip pirmą kartą, vaikams bėgti buvo truputį sunku, bet vertinam pozityviai, teigiamai, labai smagu, kad kviečia“, – džiaugiasi bėgimo dalyvė.
„Man tai labai smagu. Kuo daugiau Šiauliams, kad būtų aktyvumo. Šiaip renginių pakankamai yra, bet tų sporto gal renginių mažai“, – priduria kita LRT kalbinta dalyvė.

title: Zimbabwe: Bindura Water Pipeline Commissioned After 34-Year Wait
content:
A 22.1-kilometre Masembura water pipeline in Bindura has been commissioned, ending a project that had remained on the municipality's shelves since it was first conceptualised in 1992.
The project, commissioned on Monday, was achieved through a public-private partnership involving Bindura Municipality, Mutapa Gold Resources and the Zimbabwe National Water Authority (ZINWA), with authorities saying it is expected to improve water supplies to residents and support economic growth.
Speaking during the commissioning, Bindura Town Clerk Evelyn Madziire said the project had taken more than three decades to move from conception to implementation.
"It took all of these years to become a reality," Madziire said.

Madziire described the project as a real game changer for the town, saying reliable water supplies would help attract investment, create employment and reduce water-borne diseases.
Mashonaland Central Minister of State for Provincial Affairs and Devolution Christopher Magomo said the pipeline should result in longer hours of water availability in Bindura.
"We will be delighted if we see much more water in our taps in Bindura. That will be a milestone," Magomo said.
He said the project demonstrated the importance of partnerships between government and the private sector in addressing infrastructure gaps.
"Government cannot do everything alone. The private sector brings capital, technical expertise, innovation and other things which, if combined with public sector leadership, can accelerate the delivery of critical projects," Magomo said.
Mutapa Gold Resources representative Patrick Shayawabaya said the company accelerated the project after a sharp decline in water levels at Mwenje Dam raised concerns over supplies to both the mine and Bindura residents.
He said the dam had fallen to 36% in April 2025, a level normally reached in late October or early November before the rainy season.
"So the fact that the dam was at 36% in April was a clear red light to us that we potentially faced not having processing water at Freda in the latter part of the season, and that Bindura town would also not have water for human consumption," Shayawabaya said.
He said the company consequently invested in the long-discussed Masembura pipeline to avert a potential water crisis.
The project includes construction of a 22.1km transmission line, a 500-megalitre balancing tank and the installation of a reinforced plastic pipeline, alongside pressure testing of the system.
Bindura can now draw raw water from both Mazoe River and Masembura Dam, reducing water treatment and overall production costs while also cutting the time needed to fill reservoirs.

title: El primer día de San Mateo en Logroño se salda con 91 personas atendidas por Cruz Roja
content: 26 precisaron traslado a centros sanitarios durante los distintos dispositivos desplegados en Logroño Cruz Roja atiende a 91 personas durante la primera jornada de las Fiestas de San Mateo 2026. Un total de 26 precisaron traslado a centros sanitarios durante los distintos dispositivos desplegados en Logroño. Los recursos desplazados hasta el cohete anunciador atiendendieron a 46 personas en su mayoría por heridas, traumatismos y ataques de ansiedad. Solo 4 personas requirieron traslado a centro sanitario para valoración. En el puesto de atención situado en la Plaza del Mercado, en las horas posteriores al inicio de las Fiestas se atendieron a 15 personas de las cuales 5 fueron trasladadas a diferentes servicios de urgencias. Con este dispositivo, además de estar presente en los actos más multitudinarios de las fiestas, conseguimos un refuerzo al servicio de urgencias y emergencias del Servicio Riojano de Salud. 46 personas atendidas durante el disparo del cohete El dispositivo sanitario activado con motivo del disparo del cohete anunciador de las fiestas atendió a 46 personas, en su mayoría por heridas, traumatismos y lipotimias, todas ellas de carácter leve. De estas asistencias, una persona precisó traslado a un centro sanitario para valoración complementaria. Además, durante el desarrollo del operativo se realizaron otros tres traslados por motivos ajenos directamente al acto del cohete. Para garantizar la cobertura sanitaria del evento, Cruz Roja movilizó a alrededor de 50 personas voluntarias, distribuidas entre un Puesto Sanitario Avanzado, cuatro puestos de alerta y primeros auxilios ubicados en el perímetro de la Plaza del Ayuntamiento, cuatro ambulancias y diferentes recursos de apoyo a emergencias. Durante las horas posteriores al chupinazo, el puesto fijo de atención ubicado en la Plaza del Mercado atendió a 15 personas, de las cuales cinco requirieron traslado a centros sanitarios para su valoración. Este recurso estuvo integrado por personal médico, personal técnico en emergencias sanitarias y socorristas, apoyados por una ambulancia. La mayor parte de las asistencias estuvieron relacionadas con heridas por cortes. Las intervenciones realizadas corresponden tanto a asistencias presenciales en el propio puesto como a movilizaciones coordinadas por el Centro de Coordinación Operativa de SOS Rioja en la zona del Casco Antiguo de Logroño. Por su parte, el puesto fijo instalado en el recinto ferial atendió a una persona, que fue derivada a un centro sanitario para la realización de pruebas radiológicas complementarias. Además de la cobertura específica de los actos festivos, Cruz Roja reforzó durante la jornada la respuesta sanitaria ordinaria ante el incremento de incidencias en la vía pública. Los recursos puestos a disposición de SOS Rioja 112 realizaron 29 intervenciones, de las cuales 16 requirieron traslado a centros sanitarios, contribuyendo así a reforzar la capacidad de respuesta del sistema público de urgencias y emergencias durante una de las jornadas de mayor afluencia de público del año.
