NEW DELHI: Around 93% of those whose cases have been decided so far over not being able to vote in the West Bengal polls this year because of doubts raised about their eligibility during Election Commission's SIR drive have won their appeals and have been included in the electoral roll. However, 8,649 of 1.2 lakh lost their appeal and will be deleted.The numbers, mentioned in an annexure to an affidavit filed by EC in Supreme Court, showed that 1,13,943 could satisfy the tribunals that the commission's decision to exclude them from the roll was incorrect, and this may intensify criticism of the poll panel.Curiously, while the affidavit - filed to counter the claim of TMC and its MP, Derek O'Brien, that the exclusions cost them 31 assembly seats - puts the number of cases decided until Sept 16 at 1,26,194, the annexure stated that 1,22,592 were decided by the 24 tribunals until Sept 10.EC sources, however, said the number of disposed of cases was too low to be seen as representative of the final outcome of all cases. They also said the results might favour inclusion because cases where citizens had documentary proof were decided first.The annexure also mentioned district-wise filing of appeals by voters and disposal of cases. The appellate tribunals were set up on SC's direction that panels comprising former HC chief justices and judges would hear appeals against exclusions in the roll revision process.
A person whose claim for inclusion was rejected could approach the tribunals, which had started hearing appeals in April.Claiming that O'Brien had misled the court, EC said, "It is pertinent to note that the applicant has conspicuously ignored the other side of the very same data relied upon by it. As disclosed in the applicant's own application, in as many as 21 constituencies, the number of deletions under adjudication exceeds the margin of victory of the candidates belonging to the applicant's own party."The affidavit said that applying the very same test and reasoning propounded by the applicant, "the applicant would, therefore, equally have to seek setting aside of the election results in those constituencies won by its own party candidates".
"The selective and inconsistent application of an inherently flawed and speculative yardstick, therefore, exposes the self-serving and mala fide nature of the present application," it said.EC said the attempt to portray all deletions as "effective disenfranchisement" was wholly incorrect and misleading. "It is humbly submitted that even assuming, without admitting, the correctness of the figures relied upon by the applicant, once the removals pertaining to ineligible ASDD (absent, shifted, duplicate/dead, and demoted/displaced) entries are excluded, the applicant's own data demonstrates that in several constituencies, the number of adjud-icated deletions is lower than the margin of defeat," it said.This data, therefore, "completely demolished" the "speculative theory that the adjudication exercise altered the electoral outcome," the affidavit said.

title: Prisoners Prove Unlikely Heroes to Monarch Butterflies Thanks to Wisconsin Correctional Program
content:
Wisconsin prison inmates have been offered a unique way to give back to their community by raising monarch butterflies from the inside.
Set up at Redgranite Correctional Institute (RGCI), the idea first came to the program organizer while looking for something that inmates who were physically unable to participate in sports could do.
Now in its 2nd year, some 20 prisoners currently work in a lepidopterum purpose-built in Redgranite for raising and releasing monarchs, which are in decline across Wisconsin.
The Refuge for Growth, Change and Inspiration Monarch Program was launched in 2025 by Carrie Jahnke. It runs from June through September, during which the prison receives monarch caterpillars from a nearby breeding center, Monarch Watch, and the participants are divided into groups to look after them.
Responsibilities include changing or adding leaves, collecting data on eggs, and tagging the butterflies, all of which will help inform conservation activities as the butterflies prepare to migrate thousands of miles south to Mexico. Jahnke also provides other educational materials about monarchs, pollinator plants, and horticulture.
This delicate, rather dainty work, has nevertheless been popular among the inmates, and this year the program oversaw 100 caterpillars, up from 60 last year.
MONARCH STORIES: Number of Monarch Butterflies Wintering in Mexico is Way Up–Doubling the Forest Acreage Over Last Year
“I enjoy being part of this program and being able to give back to the community,” one inmate, Nathan Lecker, remembering raising monarch caterpillars as a child, told Corrections1. “We can make a big impact from the inside.”
Correctional Dept. landscapers have added a variety of monarch-friendly flower beds around the prison grounds to provide additional support to the insects when they leave the enclosure, after emerging from their chrysalises.

It takes just 2 to 3 days of building up their strength before they’re ready for their long flight south.
“Monarch butterfly populations have been declining for years, and it’s wonderful that RGCI is getting involved with efforts to conserve them,” said Shelly Torkelson, communications director for the Natural Resources Foundation of Wisconsin, which helped build the lepidopterum inside the facility.

title: Menyasszonyként vágott bele a fogyókúrába, 50 kilóval könnyebben mondta ki az igent
content:
Menyasszonyként vágott bele a fogyókúrába, 50 kilóval könnyebben mondta ki az igent
Emilie Heeks egyetlen nagy célt tűzött ki maga elé, szerette volna magabiztosabban érezni magát a testében, mielőtt lefoglalja az esküvője időpontját. A 26 éves brit menyasszony januárban kezdett életmódot váltani, és végül körülbelül ötven kilogrammot fogyott.
Emilie egy bevásárló áruházban dolgozik, és nagyjából 113 kilogrammos testsúllyal csatlakozott egy helyi edzés csoporthoz. Szerette volna jobban érezni magát a bőrében, és eljutni oda, hogy magabiztosan tervezhesse a nagy napját. Tudatosan döntött úgy, hogy nem használ fogyókúrás injekciókat. Úgy gondolta, hogy hosszú távon így is, úgy is meg kell tanulnia, hogyan étkezzen, és hogyan érezze jól magát ilyenek nélkül.
Ezért inkább az életmódváltásra, a számára fenntartható étkezési szokásokra és a fokozatos fogyásra helyezte a hangsúlyt. A célja nem egy gyors megoldás volt, hanem az, hogy olyan változtatásokat alakítson ki, amelyekhez később is tud tartani magát. Az egész végül az esküvőjén teljesedett ki, a képeken már a nagy napján látható, magabiztosan és boldogan.

title: Lugha za kigeni zinavyowalipa watu Kariakoo
content:
Lugha za kigeni zinavyowalipa watu Kariakoo
Dar es Salaam. Kariakoo ni zaidi ya biashara kama watu wengi wanavyoitazama, kwani ndani ya shughuli za kila siku baadhi ya watu wamekuwa wakijipatia kipato kutokana na ujuzi wa kuzungumza lugha za kigeni.
Kuanzia Kiingereza, Kireno, Kifaransa, lugha mama za baadhi ya nchi kama Kiwemba kwa wale Zambia imekuwa ni fursa kwao ya kujiingizia kipato kwani wamekuwa daraja muhimu katika kuhakikisha biashara kati ya watanzania na wageni hao wa kimataifa inafanikiwa.
Ujuzi wa lugha hii kwa vijana, haimaanishi wote wameingia darasani bali baadhi wamejifunza kutokana na kuwasikiliza wageni hao na kulazimika kutafuta namna ya kuwasiliana nao kwa urahisi.
Mawinga wamekuwa katika nafasi kubwa ya kunufaika na fursa hii kutokana na kuwa na muda wa kutosha kuzunguka na wageni hao wanapoingia sokoni huku malipo yao yakitegemeana na huduma wanayotoa.
Wengine waliopewa jina la ‘runner’ wao malipo yao hufikia hadi asilimia 10 ya mzigo anaonunua mteja huyo huku akihakikisha mawasiliano kati yake na wenye maduka ni mepesi na hayana vikwazo vyovyote. Baadhi yao pia wameingia makubaliano na wamiliki wa maduka ambao pia huwapatia asilimia katika manunuzi ya wateja wanaowapeleka.
Lugha pekee imefanya baadhi yao kukiri kuwa ndiyo msingi wa kile wanachokifanya, kufungua maduka huku wengine wakiendelea kufurahia hela isiyolazimika kupitia katika mikono mingi kabla ya kufika kwao.
“Mimi nazungumza Kireno na Kifaransa, wateja kutoka Msumbiji, jamhuri ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo wengi ninawahudumia, imefika wakati ambao wengine wameshaacha kuja nchini ila wanaendelea na biashara kama kawaida kwa sababu nawahudumia,” anasema Moses Kunajenga ambaye ni winga Kariakoo.
Anasema katika shule aliyosoma Kireno na Kifaransa ilikuwa sehemu ya masomo lakini hakujua kama itafika wakati ambao lugha hizo zitageuka kuwa chanzo cha kipato.“Nilianza kama utani mwaka 2022, nikiwa hapa sokoni nasubiri wateja nilipata mtu kutoka Congo akiwa anababaika na Kiswahili nilimsemesha Kifaransa akajibu na tukazungumza tukaelewa, baada ya hapo akanipa Sh100,000 kama asante nikaona kumbe ni kitu naweza kukitumia,” anasema.
Tangu hapo alianza kutumia ujuzi wa lugha alizonazo kusaidia wageni wanaofika Kariakoo huku wakati mwingine akiwasaka hadi kwenye hoteli au kuongea na wahudumu wa hoteli za karibu ili wamuunganishe kwa urahisi.
“Kilichotokea, wale ambao niliwahudumia waliwapa namba wengine ambao waliendelea kuwasiliana na mimi kila walipokuja nchini. Wengine wanatuma pesa ninawanunulia mzigo na kuwatumia huko waliko huku mimi na wao tukikubaliana nitapata asilimia ngapi ya manunuzi wanayofanya,” anasema.
Mbali na kuzungusha wateja kwa Jonas Msafiri ambaye amekuwa akijihusisha na biashara na kuwahudumia wafanyabiashara kutoka nchi mbalimbali anasema lugha ni sehemu muhimu ya biashara ya Kariakoo hasa kwa wateja wanaotoka nje ya Tanzania.
Anasema wafanyabiashara wanaojua lugha wanapata nafasi ya kuwahudumia wateja ambao wasingeweza kuwasiliana kwa urahisi na wauzaji wengine huku akisema wasiojua lugha za kigeni kuwa wanafanya biashara kwa calculator.
“Yaani unapata mteja kutoka nje akikuuliza hii bei gani kwa lugha yake unaandika kwenye calculator unamwonyesha, kila anachouliza unamjibu kwa namba hiyo ni tofauti na yule anayejua lugha za kigeni ambaye anaweza kumwelezea mteja vizuri hadi wakaelewana na biashara kufanikiwa,” anasema.
Anasema ujuzi huo wa lugha mwaka 2021 akiwa kama winga tu alikuwa na uwezo wa kufunga hadi Sh5 milioni kwa mwezi kutokana na kuhudumia wageni kutoka mataifa mbalimbali kupata bidhaa wanazohitaji kwa urahisi.
Maneno ya Msafiri yanaungwa mkono na Regis Masawe ambaye kwa sasa ni mmiliki wa duka anayesema wageni wanaofika Kariakoo mara nyingi hukutana na changamoto ya lugha jambo linalofanya baadhi yao kutumia wakalimani ili kuwasaidia kufanya manunuzi.
“Yaani Mkongo akija akifika hotelini, anamtafuta yule mtu ambaye anajua lugha ili amtafsirie na kusaidia biashara kufanyika kwa haraka,” anasema.
Hata hivyo, hali hii imeanza kupungua polepole kwa sababu baadhi ya nchi wameleta watu wao ili wawasaidie katika biashara wanapokuja nchini kufanya manunuzi hali inayopunguza fursa kwa wazawa licha ya kutokuwa na uwezo wa kuzimaliza.
Huduma kwa wazawa
Huduma hii ya kupelekwa duka hadi duka pia hutolewa kwa wazawa ambao si wenyeji wa mitaa ya Kariakoo ambao mwisho wa siku hulazimika kuwaachia fedha kidogo kama malipo ya huduma waliyopewa.
Uwinga na teknolojia
Mbali na kuwatembeza, Masawe anasema mfumo wa uwinga Kariakoo pia unapitia mabadiliko makubwa hasa baada ya Uviko-19 ambapo teknolojia na mifumo ya malipo ilianza kurahisisha biashara kati ya wafanyabiashara na wateja waliokuwa mbali.
Anasema kabla ya Corona, mtu aliyeko mkoani au nje ya nchi alikuwa anaona ugumu wa kutuma fedha kabla hajapata mzigo lakini kuanzia mwaka 2020 hali ilianza kubadilika na watu wakaanza kufanya biashara kwa kuaminiana bila kukutana ana kwa ana.

title: Lapset palasivat kouluun Gazassa
content:
Gazassa koulut ovat avautuneet ensi kertaa lähes kolmeen vuoteen.
Koulut suljettiin syksyllä 2023 sodan vuoksi. Israel aloitti laajat sotatoimet Gazassa sen jälkeen, kun islamistinen terroristijärjestö Hamas iski Israeliin lokakuussa 2023. Hamasin iskussa kuoli yli tuhat israelilaista. YK:n lastenjärjestö Unicefin mukaan Israelin iskuissa on kuollut yli 70 000 palestiinalaista.
Lisäksi lähes kaikki Gazan koulut ovat joko tuhoutuneet tai vaurioituneet sotatoimien seurauksena, Unicef sanoo. Gazan viranomaisten mukaan sodassa on kuollut 22 000 opiskelijaa ja yli 500 opettajaa.
Nyt Gazaan on avattu kymmeniä väliaikaisia kouluja. Paikalliset viranomaiset odottavat jopa puolen miljoonan opiskelijan osallistuvan opetukseen tänä lukuvuonna.
